# V3 aggregate: 3x3 probe x metric grid (auto-generated by aggregate.py)

Primary level: 0.9; equivalence margin: +-0.05 KL. All CIs are cluster bootstrap by template subject (ci_type per run in checks.json) unless noted.
Confirmatory comparisons: Q1-Q4 only. Everything else is exploratory (hypothesis generation).
Multiple comparisons: no correction applied (uncorrected). frac_ctx_b_better is a fraction of paired contexts, not a p-value.
